en.title: Buying a Tavelo frame: official routes, dealer stock and model generations
en.description: Where to start a Tavelo purchase, how to treat older Attack owner reports, and what to confirm when ordering a current Arden frame and cockpit.
en.intro: Tavelo research has one easy way to go wrong: an older owner’s bike, a new product photo and a dealer’s current listing can look like one story when they concern different frames. Keep the names and generations attached.

sections.heading: Start at tavelo.cc and its dealer locator
paragraphs: Use the [Tavelo brand site](https://www.tavelo.cc/) and [dealer locator](https://tavelo.cc/pages/dealer). Check the domain carefully; a similar name in search results does not establish that you are looking at the bicycle company.

Ask the relevant seller for the exact model, generation, size, finish and cockpit. If a product page shows out of stock, ask whether that means no warehouse stock, no allocated incoming stock or no order availability at all. Those are different answers.

The Arden pictured here is the model identified in our [catalog record](/models/tavelo-arden/). It is not a visual stand-in for every Tavelo frame, and the assembled bike in a marketing image does not define your frameset’s contents.

sections.heading: An old Attack purchase is a lead, not a current stock check
paragraphs: In a [February 2024 discussion](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=4757.0), an Attack owner described purchasing the frame and another reply suggested contacting Panda Podium even when the web listing appeared unavailable. That is a dated account of a buying route, not confirmation of current stock or authorization.
Use the current brand directory to verify today’s seller relationship. Then ask about your exact frame. Do not treat an old Attack delivery or build experience as a review of the Arden.

Forum comparisons sometimes suggest that visually similar frames share a mold or factory. Unless there is attributable evidence for the exact products, resemblance does not establish construction, quality control or warranty equivalence. A buying decision needs more than a convincing silhouette.

sections.heading: Price the cockpit and its future adjustments
paragraphs: Obtain the current geometry and assembly information through the [brand’s support downloads](https://tavelo.cc/download/), or ask the seller for the exact manual. Share the chosen front end with the person fitting and assembling the bike before you settle the order.

Ask which spacers, top cover, hardware and mounts are included and how replacements are obtained. If you later need a different bar width or stem length, establish which approved options remain available and what the change involves.
Compare frame quotes with the same cockpit package. A cheaper listing that omits a required part can become the more expensive route once shipping and workshop time join the bill.

sections.heading: Keep the handover responsibilities clear
paragraphs: Record who sells the frame, who dispatches it, and who handles a defect claim. Ask for the delivered total, import-charge treatment, expected dispatch and the conditions for changing or cancelling the order.

Before assembly, photograph the supplied parts and preserve labels and packaging. Ask the seller to resolve any mismatch against the agreed specification before the build turns it into a harder-to-document problem.
A good Tavelo purchase is a complete agreement about one exact frame. The owner threads are useful companions, but the invoice and the current seller’s answers should be doing the heavy lifting.

zh-Hans.title: Tavelo 车架购买指南：官方渠道、经销库存与车型代际
zh-Hans.description: Tavelo 购买从哪里开始，如何看待旧 Attack 车主经历，以及订购当前 Arden 车架和把组时需要确认什么。
zh-Hans.intro: 研究 Tavelo 很容易把旧车主的车、新产品照片和经销商当前商品拼成同一个故事，其实它们可能是不同车架。型号与代际要始终对应。

sections.heading: 从 tavelo.cc 和经销商查询开始
paragraphs: 使用 [Tavelo 品牌官网](https://www.tavelo.cc/)及[经销商查询](https://tavelo.cc/pages/dealer)。核对域名，搜索结果中的相似名字不代表自行车公司。
向卖家询问具体型号、代际、尺码、颜色和把组。页面显示缺货时，要区分仓里没有、即将到货但未分配，还是根本不能下单。
照片中的 Arden 对应[目录记录](/models/tavelo-arden/)，不是所有 Tavelo 车架的通用替身。宣传整车配置也不自动等于车架套餐内含。

sections.heading: 旧 Attack 购买经历不是当前库存证明
paragraphs: 在 [2024 年 2 月讨论](https://chinertown.com/index.php?topic=4757.0)中，一位 Attack 车主谈到购买，另一回复建议即使网页似乎缺货，也可联系 Panda Podium。这是有日期的渠道经历，不证明当前库存或授权。
通过当前品牌名单核对今天的卖家关系，再问具体车架。不要把老 Attack 的交付和装车体验当成 Arden 评测。
论坛有时推测外形相似的车架共享模具或工厂。没有针对具体产品的可归属证据，外观相似不能证明结构、品控或保修等同。购买决定需要的不只是相似轮廓。

sections.heading: 把把组及日后调整算进去
paragraphs: 通过[品牌资料下载](https://tavelo.cc/download/)取得当前几何与装配信息，或请卖家提供准确手册。最终下单前，把前端方案交给负责 fitting 和装车的人。
确认垫圈、上盖、紧固件和支架哪些包含，替换件如何买。若以后需要不同把宽或把立长度，问还有哪些厂家允许的选项，以及更换需要做什么。
按相同把组套餐比较车架报价。较便宜但缺少必需件的方案，加上运费和工时后可能反而贵。

sections.heading: 把交付责任讲清楚
paragraphs: 记录销售方、发货方及缺陷索赔责任方。问到手总额、进口费用处理、预计发货，以及修改或取消订单的条件。
装车前拍下内含部件并保留标签和包装。若与约定不符，先让卖家处理，别装好后才变成更难说明的问题。
好的 Tavelo 交易，应是围绕一款准确车架形成的完整约定。车主帖可以辅助，但最终要依靠发票与当前卖家的明确答复。
